title: PACE: Periodic and Channel-Aligned Encoding of Four-Bit Recurrent States
abstract: arXiv:2610.29545v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Linear-attention language models keep their context in a recurrent state of fixed size, where an inference system stores one copy of this state for every sequence it decodes at the same time. Storing the state at lower precision therefore lets more sequences share an accelerator. Existing state quantizers round the state after every generated token and report that four bits lose accuracy unless the bit width is raised or the model is fine-tuned.\par We introduce PACE, a post-hoc four-bit state quantizer. PACE rounds the state only once every few generated tokens, as chunked kernels already do once per chunk during prefill, and keeps the tokens generated in between in a small buffer. Rounding less often reduces the error that accumulates in the state. Additionally, we find that the large entries of the gated-delta state gather in columns, because some channels of the update written at each token remain large across many tokens. PACE there

translated_title: PACE：四比特循环状态的周期性与通道对齐编码
translated_abstract: 线性注意力语言模型将上下文保存在一个固定大小的循环状态中，推理系统会为同时解码的每个序列存储一份该状态的副本。因此，以较低精度存储该状态可以让更多序列共享同一个加速器。现有的状态量化器在每生成一个 token 后就对状态进行舍入，并报告称除非提高比特宽度或对模型进行微调，否则四比特精度会带来损失。我们提出了 PACE，一种事后的四比特状态量化器。PACE 每隔几个生成的 token 才对状态进行一次舍入——正如分块内核在预填充阶段每个块只执行一次那样——并将中间生成的 token 保存在一个小缓冲区中。降低舍入频率减少了在状态中不断累积的误差。此外，我们发现门控增量（gated-delta）状态中的大数值条目会聚集在某些列上，原因是每次 token 写入的更新中，某些通道的数值在许多 token 之间持续保持较大。PACE 基于这一通道对齐的特性……
tldr: PACE 提出一种事后的四比特状态量化方法，通过每隔几个 token 才周期性地对循环状态进行一次舍入，并利用大数值条目在通道上聚集对齐的结构特性，减少舍入误差累积，从而在不微调模型的情况下实现高精度的四比特推理状态存储。
en_tdlr: PACE is a post-hoc four-bit state quantizer that rounds the recurrent state only periodically every few generated tokens and exploits the channel-aligned structure of large state entries, reducing accumulated rounding error to enable accurate four-bit state storage without fine-tuning.
